padding: time-major [4,64,2]; invalid rows sanitized before math; losses average valid rows; empty minibatches skip Adam
shuffle: permute all 512 rows with Threefry domain SHF, version, epoch; stable-partition valid rows first; 4 fixed minibatches per epoch
optimizer_bias: FP32(1-beta**step) table for steps 1..20000; exact FP32 one thereafter
checkpoint_mode: completed whole-episode update boundary; atomic rollback only
soak_stop: elapsed monotonic wall time >=60 after warmup; numerical qualification only; no two-hour stability claim for this new policy
final_evaluation: sealed; no reads of final episode data or new final games
